title: Kissed Australian Mango Sushi
description: A satvik-friendly twist on sushi with roasted mango glaze and nigiri-style rice balls, perfect for a quick lunch or dessert.
instructions: Rinse the glutinous rice until water runs clear.
Cook the rice with 200 ml water until it is sticky and fully cooked.
Whisk together the rice vinegar, sugar, and pinch of salt until dissolved.
Fold the seasoning into the hot rice and allow it to cool slightly.
Shape the cooled rice into small, flat nigiri-style balls, about the size of a thumb.
Brush the mango slices with a thin coating of canola oil.
Place the mango slices on a preheated skillet over medium heat and roast for 5 minutes on each side until caramelized.
Remove the mango from the skillet and let it cool, then drizzle a thin layer of the same oil over it to create a glossy glaze.
Place a mango slice on top of each rice ball and garnish with cucumber slices, roasted sesame seeds, and mint leaves.
Serve immediately, enjoying the sweet, savory, and refreshing bite of the kissed Australian mango sushi.
